name: Downtown Cafe Bar & Grill
notes: First-party Google Sites domain. The everyday Lunch/Dinner FOOD menu (Appetizers, Salads, Soups, Burgers, Sandwiches, Baskets, Flat-Breads, Pastas, Tacos, Fajitas, Wraps, House Specialties - ~50 item names) renders on /menu with NO price anywhere in the DOM for any item - not gated, not paginated, just absent from the markup - so those items are dropped per 'never write a dish without a real price'. What IS priced and filed: the Happy Hour board embedded on the same /menu page (2-5:30pm; two relative '$X off' lines dropped, only absolute prices kept); a Soups & Combos block on /menu; the dated '2026 DTC BRUNCH.pdf' (Sunday brunch, 10:30-1:30, full priced menu incl. drink specials and sides); and the dated '2026 DTC menudrinkew.pdf' bar menu (wine/cocktails/sangria/shakers/margaritas). The bar PDF is 2-column and pdftotext -layout initially scrambled Martinis pairing, so Martinis were dropped entirely (no reliable name-price pairing found even in -raw mode) rather than guessed; every other section's pairing was confirmed identical across -layout and -raw. Draft Beer/Bottles/Cans/High Noons/Bourbon&Rye brand lists carry no prices anywhere and are excluded as unpriced adjuncts, same as the Martinis. The homepage also links a '2026 BUFFET MENU.pdf' - excluded as a private-party catering package (25-person minimum, per-package price, tied to the site's separate /events/private-parties page), not the everyday menu. An older 'Drink Menu.png' embedded on the homepage/menu landing page shows different (lower) wine and shaker prices than the dated 2026 PDF; treated as a stale duplicate and not used. Shaker drinks and the Cadillac/house margaritas each carry two size tiers (e.g. glass/24oz shaker); the smaller tier is recorded as the price and the upsize noted in the description. No markup/fee signal found - this is static first-party informational content, not an ordering channel.

name: The Pancake House
notes: The worklist domain (thepancakehousebirthdayclub.com) is a third-party eBirthdayClubs signup widget with no menu content of any kind - not the restaurant's own site. No ordering platform found. The only reachable priced source is this restaurant's SinglePlatform listing (tier 4, restaurant-submitted, undated), whose schema.org JSON-LD parses cleanly to 24 priced items across Hamburgers, Classic Clubs, Delightful Sandwiches, Traditional Favorites (steaks) and Special Rewards (desserts) - address on the listing matches the worklist exactly (1000 N 2nd St, El Cajon, CA 92021). This is a PARTIAL, not the whole menu: it carries no breakfast or pancake items at all, which is the core identity of a restaurant literally named 'The Pancake House' - that section was never reached because SinglePlatform simply does not have it, not because it was skipped. A WebSearch summary (atly.com) surfaced different, higher figures for some of the same dish names with irregular cents (Hamburger $6.70 vs a summarized $6.70 - actually matched; but Steak and Eggs $21.44, French Toast $17.93 with no counterpart on SinglePlatform) - not used, since it is a single uncorroborated aggregator snippet, not a page read directly. Cents distribution here (.99/.89/.69/.59/.49/.29/.19/.95) is broad and POS-like, no divisor artifact found - reads as genuine menu pricing, just possibly dated given SinglePlatform's known staleness. One clean size-variant pair found outside the JSON-LD block and included: Ice Cream 1 scoop $1.85 / 2 scoops $3.19. Modifier add-on lines embedded in descriptions ('add bacon $0.99', 'add cheese $0.89', 'Add Soup or Salad $0.99') were left as description text only, not filed as separate dishes.
